{{< include /knowledge/includes/reactive-params.qmd >}}

This page tests the recursive parameter disclosure tree. Below is the cost of the
Loving Takeover per human. Click any calculated value to expand its formula and
inputs. Drag a leaf slider and watch every parent recompute.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof takeoverTree = paramTree("DEFENSE_TAKEOVER_COST_PER_HUMAN")
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
The live value the tree reports (downstream OJS reacts to edits):
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
md`**Current cost per human:** ${fmtValue(paramData["DEFENSE_TAKEOVER_COST_PER_HUMAN"], takeoverTree["DEFENSE_TAKEOVER_COST_PER_HUMAN"])}`
```

::: {.content-hidden when-format="html"}

(Interactive parameter editor available in the web edition.) The default
per-person cost of the defense takeover is {{< var defense_takeover_cost_per_human >}}.

:::
